acceptance.given: An A12 evaluation input contains a read-set self-collision and all unrelated inputs remain unchanged.

oracle.expected: The A12 evaluation reports collision rejection for the read-set self-collision.
oracle.observable: The collision fixture's A12 evaluation result and exit status.

acceptance.when: The A12 collision fixture is evaluated.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the isolated A12 collision fixture and require the selector to fail while collision rejection is absent or the self-collision is accepted or ignored.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Reject an A12 read-set self-collision during knowledge-collision evaluation.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Logic-only rollback; no persisted state or schema migration.

slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The isolated A12 collision selector passes only when the collision is rejected and fails if it is accepted or ignored.

acceptance.given: A valid evaluation seed record and its prior content identity are available, with all unrelated inputs held constant.

oracle.expected: The evaluation classifies the seed as stale after its content identity changes.
forbidden: Changed seed content is treated as current.
oracle.observable: The isolated seed-mutation fixture's seed status.

acceptance.when: The seed-mutation fixture changes only the seed content and evaluation is run.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the isolated seed-mutation case and require failure until changed seed content is classified stale.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Classify an evaluation seed as stale when its content changes.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Logic-only rollback; existing replay and seed artifacts remain readable and no schema migration is introduced.

slice_hint.state_transition: seed content changed -> seed status stale
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The isolated seed-mutation selector passes only when changed content produces stale and fails if it remains current.

acceptance.given: An otherwise unchanged replay evaluation uses output whose validator identity is represented only by forged version text.

oracle.expected: Trust is rejected and no trusted Replay Result is produced from the forged version text.
forbidden: The forged version text is trusted as validator identity proof.
A trusted Replay Result is produced based only on forged version text.
oracle.observable: The isolated forged-output fixture's trust decision and Replay Result trust status.

acceptance.when: The isolated forged-output fixture is evaluated with all other inputs held constant.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the isolated forged-output case and require failure until version text alone cannot establish validator identity or produce a trusted Replay Result.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Reject validator trust when identity is supported only by forged descriptive version text.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Logic-only rollback; existing replay receipts remain readable and no schema migration is introduced.

slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The isolated forged-output selector passes only when trust is rejected and no trusted Replay Result is emitted from version text alone.

acceptance.given: An isolated Phase fixture requests a write to a Phase file while all unrelated inputs remain unchanged.

oracle.expected: At scope-boundary evaluation, the Phase fixture reports rejection of the attempted Phase file write before any write is applied.
forbidden: The Phase file write is accepted.
The Phase fixture is evaluated with other inputs changed.
oracle.observable: The Phase fixture's scope-boundary decision and unchanged Phase target checked during boundary evaluation.

acceptance.then: The Phase file write is rejected.
acceptance.when: The isolated Phase fixture attempts the write and the scope boundary is evaluated before mutation.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the isolated Phase-boundary fixture and fail the boundary check if the Phase path is writable, the write is accepted, or unrelated inputs differ.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Reject proposed writes that target Phase files at pre-mutation scope-boundary evaluation.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Policy-logic rollback only; no Phase file, persisted state, or schema is changed.

slice_hint.state_transition: Phase file write requested -> write rejected before mutation
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The isolated Phase-boundary selector passes only when the requested Phase write is rejected before mutation and unrelated fixture inputs remain unchanged.
